product: SAP CAP / Cloud MTA Build Tool npm packages
source_title: TeamPCP-Linked Supply Chain Attack Hits SAP CAP and Cloud MTA npm Packages
claim_summary: Malicious versions mbt@1.2.48, @cap-js/db-service@2.10.1, @cap-js/postgres@2.2.2 and @cap-js/sqlite@2.2.2 added a preinstall script that downloads Bun and runs an obfuscated credential stealer with self-propagation via stolen npm tokens; Socket attributes it to TeamPCP-linked activity with medium confidence
feature: supply-chain compromise of SAP developer packages
availability: malicious versions no longer listed in npm registry on 2026-10-16; fixed versions published
limitation: Attribution is the researcher's medium-confidence assessment; download figures are Socket estimates; victim count unknown

product: SAP CAP / Cloud MTA Build Tool npm packages
source_title: A Mini Shai-Hulud Has Appeared: Obfuscated Bun Runtime Payloads Hit SAP-Related npm Packages
claim_summary: Second independent analysis of the same incident: two attack paths about two hours apart, a static npm automation token for mbt (no OIDC trusted publishing) and a compromised developer GitHub account pushing a modified release workflow to cap-js/cds-dbs; the malicious commit carried a spoofed AI-assistant author identity without a verified signature
feature: CI/CD release workflow abuse; unsigned spoofed commit identity
limitation: Same incident as 084-005 (one event, two analyses); vendor-side post-incident report not found; npm registry times 2026-04-29T09:55Z (mbt 1.2.48) and 11:25Z (@cap-js/sqlite 2.2.2) confirmed
